question: Receivables Exchange of India Ltd (RXIL) was incorporated in 2016 as a joint venture between Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) and the ______.

options.text: National Stock Exchange of India Limited

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Stock Exchange of India Limited.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Receivables Exchange of India Ltd (RXIL)** was incorporated on February 25, 2016 as a joint venture between **Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) and National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Stock Exchange** is a government-owned stock exchange in India.

 
 
• It is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• It was established in 1992.
 
• It uses NIFTY 50 as its index.
 
• Nifty was introduced by NSE on April 21, 1996.
 
• It represents the weighted average of 50 Indian Company Stocks across 24 sectors, which account for around 60% of the market capitalization.
 
 
 
• ​**SIDBI **was established with the mission of facilitating and strengthening the flow of credit to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.
 
 
• It is a statutory body set up under an act of the** Indian Parliament in 1990.**
 
• It was set up on** 2nd April 1990.**
 
• Headquartered- **Lucknow**.
